subject.title: fix(codex): fail closed on unknown projector statuses and warn on protocol drift

question: Should OpenClaw intentionally fail closed for explicit unknown Codex item statuses instead of continuing to project them as completed?
rationale: The change is a correctness fix for protocol drift, but it intentionally changes upgrade behavior for any future or custom Codex status value.

options.title: Accept Fail-Closed Semantics
options.body: After proof and the warning-scope cleanup, treat explicit unknown statuses as failed so protocol drift is visible instead of silently successful.

options.title: Define Softer Unknown Handling
options.body: Pause this PR and define a dedicated unknown/non-success projection contract if maintainers do not want future benign statuses to fail.

recommendation.title: Accept Fail-Closed Semantics
recommendation.body: After proof and the warning-scope cleanup, treat explicit unknown statuses as failed so protocol drift is visible instead of silently successful.
